models.title: Top of the gate
models.subtitle: Independent top reference
models.description: The separately captured top of the gate. Retained at its original detail; its alignment to the complete site is not yet verified.
models.note: Top of the gate. Independent reference: insufficient common features for a validated placement in the main model.

method: The gate and surrounding stones were reconstructed together from 1,054 aligned survey photographs. The Blender master retains 12.7 million triangles and eleven 8K photographic texture atlases. Standard and high-detail versions bring the same site to the browser. Cleaned Polycam scans are retained as supporting references.
limitation: Open edges and gaps reflect capture coverage. Dimensions have not been checked against survey control. The separately captured top of the gate could not be reliably registered and remains an independent reference; no missing architecture has been invented.
